## Overview

Big ideas need people who can make them happen. From launching new technology and transforming businesses to improving public services and healthcare, project management is at the heart of progress.

On this MSc, you’ll develop the knowledge and practical skills to plan, manage and deliver projects in a wide range of professional environments. Explore how global business, virtual and hybrid working, and emerging trends are reshaping the way projects are run, while learning to navigate complexity, manage competing priorities and turn plans into results.
